key_rotation.compromise_response: rotate signing keys, revoke affected work orders/capability grants, quarantine derived evidence until revalidated

non_cryptographic_safety_assumptions: cryptographic signatures do not prove model alignment or data quality
physical safety still requires local safety veto and device firmware/controller guarantees
prompt text, metadata, extensions, and model outputs are not authority
operator and governance workflows require independent authorization evidence

security_review_checklist.question: Does the schema add, move, or reinterpret identity, authority, approval, credential, data-use, quota, policy, gateway, verifier, or driver fields?
security_review_checklist.required_evidence: documented authorizing fields, non-authorizing extension treatment, fail-closed unknown-field behavior, and compatibility impact

security_review_checklist.question: Can the operation cause filesystem, network, database, shell, cloud, artifact, credential, device, or other external effects?
security_review_checklist.required_evidence: gateway/driver mediation, verifier chain, idempotency or explicit non-idempotency handling, and no replay live-effect path

security_review_checklist.question: Which event, evidence, state, artifact, and replay records prove allow, denial, containment, or uncertainty?
security_review_checklist.required_evidence: required event kinds, evidence links, redaction path, and replay/simulation no-live-effect behavior

security_review_checklist.question: Could protected data, eval cases, rewards, secrets, credentials, or private artifacts leak through payloads, prompts, logs, traces, artifacts, or provider diagnostics?
security_review_checklist.required_evidence: data-use and secret-scope checks, redaction expectations, forbidden payload tests, and trace-safe diagnostic policy

security_review_checklist.question: What fail-closed containment action happens when verifier, policy, identity, revocation, attestation, or safety status is unavailable or suspicious?
security_review_checklist.required_evidence: deny/pause/quarantine/fence/revoke/degrade/rollback/safe-stop mapping with owning service and incident classification

invariants.name: Prompt/data injection through perceptor
invariants.principal: agent principal bound by tenant/work-order scope
invariants.attacker_capability: malicious percept payload attempts to smuggle instructions, capability grants, or gateway bypass text

enforcement.enforcing_component: agent route runtime with authority and gateway verifiers

maturity_gate.non_claim: mapping only; G80 remains not exercised until an adversarial route/gateway harness passes

invariants.name: Malicious dataset poisoning

trust_boundary.name: external or collected data to governed dataset snapshot boundary

invariants.principal: data collection or training workload principal
invariants.attacker_capability: malicious data source injects poisoned records or mislabeled examples into a candidate input

enforcement.enforcing_component: data quality gate and artifact lineage service

maturity_gate.non_claim: mapping only; G81 remains not exercised until poisoning fixture and quarantine harness pass

invariants.name: Secret exfiltration attempt

trust_boundary.name: secret reference lease to driver/network boundary

invariants.principal: workload or adapter principal with narrowed secret-reference scope
invariants.attacker_capability: user code or model output attempts to copy a secret into prompts, artifacts, logs, traces, or outbound network calls

enforcement.enforcing_component: authority secret-reference checks plus gateway egress verifier

maturity_gate.non_claim: mapping only; G82 remains not exercised until secret/non-disclosure and egress-denial harness pass

invariants.name: Compromised worker

trust_boundary.name: worker/node output to authoritative artifact and lease boundary

invariants.principal: worker or node principal holding a scoped execution lease
invariants.attacker_capability: compromised worker forges receipts, checkpoints, or outputs after losing trust or lease authority

enforcement.enforcing_component: fabric lease controller with artifact integrity validation

maturity_gate.non_claim: mapping only; G83 remains not exercised until worker compromise, signature rejection, and quarantine harness pass

invariants.name: Eval leakage attempt

trust_boundary.name: trainer/candidate process to protected evaluator boundary

invariants.principal: trainer, candidate, or improvement workload principal
invariants.attacker_capability: candidate/trainer attempts to read hidden eval cases or answer keys before gate evaluation

enforcement.enforcing_component: evaluation service with authority and data-use checks

maturity_gate.non_claim: mapping only; G84 remains not exercised until protected eval isolation harness passes

invariants.name: Reward-channel tampering

trust_boundary.name: feedback/reward signal to promotion gate boundary

invariants.principal: feedback source, reward derivation workload, or candidate gate principal
invariants.attacker_capability: malicious actor changes reward values, lineage, or source evidence to make a candidate appear safe

enforcement.enforcing_component: feedback/reward evidence service plus change gate

maturity_gate.non_claim: mapping only; G85 remains not exercised until reward anti-tamper and gate-denial harness pass

invariants.name: Driver schema confusion

trust_boundary.name: typed invocation request to driver operation ABI boundary

invariants.principal: driver invocation principal scoped by work order and capability
invariants.attacker_capability: caller supplies mismatched schema, version, or operation payload to trigger unintended driver behavior

enforcement.enforcing_component: driver registry and gateway schema verifier

maturity_gate.non_claim: partial conformance denial fixture exists for schema/version mismatch; G86 remains mapped_not_exercised until a full executable gold harness covers driver registry, ABI negotiation, and runtime integration

invariants.name: Duplicate irreversible action

trust_boundary.name: retry/replay request to irreversible driver effect boundary

invariants.principal: action gateway or replay principal requesting an irreversible effect
invariants.attacker_capability: retry storm or replay attempt tries to repeat an irreversible side effect without a distinct explicit authorization

enforcement.enforcing_component: action gateway idempotency and replay-safety verifier

maturity_gate.non_claim: mapping only; G87 remains not exercised until duplicate/replay irreversible-effect fixture passes

invariants.name: Expired offline policy

trust_boundary.name: offline cached policy to physical/device action boundary

invariants.principal: resident device or edge node principal operating while disconnected
invariants.attacker_capability: network partition or stale cache causes a node to use expired policy for high-risk or physical actions

enforcement.enforcing_component: node/device policy cache with local safety verifier

maturity_gate.non_claim: mapping only; G88 remains not exercised until offline policy and device-safe degraded-mode harness pass

invariants.name: Rollout blast-radius breach

trust_boundary.name: candidate deployment plan to active fleet version boundary

invariants.principal: change or deployment principal attempting to activate a candidate
invariants.attacker_capability: malicious or faulty rollout exceeds canary scope, asks for new leases, or suppresses abort/rollback signals

enforcement.enforcing_component: change/deployment controller with fleet lease admission

maturity_gate.non_claim: mapping only; G89 remains not exercised until rollout blast-radius and rollback harness pass
